summary: Completed Module 01 VERIFY: Hypothesis-First Debugging reflection on Bug #1 and Bug #2
evidence: Reflected on Bug #1: Error messages report the point of failure (symptom), not necessarily the root cause; demonstrated that 'Cannot connect to database' pointed to DB code but was rooted in configuration variable mismatch
Formulated mitigation strategy: Read error messages as symptoms, formulate falsifiable hypotheses, and run targeted verification commands prior to modifying code or restarting services
Reflected on Bug #2: Off-by-one pagination bugs frequently pass visual inspection; testing actual outputs across page boundaries revealed skipped items immediately
Confirmed value of empirical verification over code skimming: Multi-page query sampling proved offset=(page-1)*limit and ORDER BY eliminated boundary duplication and non-deterministic drift
